SELECT * INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_BU_20240222 FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct

TRUNCATE TABLE BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct


 exec [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT_CCD]
 GO
 exec [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DEP]
 GO
 exec [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT_LNS]
 GO
 exec [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT_TRU]
 GO
 exec [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT_SEC]
 GO
----------------------------Record count------------------------

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
AS(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY FileDateKey DESC, FILETYPE DESC ) RN, * FROM 
    (
    SELECT
    BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS PeriodStartDate
    ,'99991231' AS PeriodEndDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PDT_NBR AS ProductId
    ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,FILE_NAME AS FileName
    ,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS FileDateKey
    ,'Monthly' AS filetype
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
    WHERE  BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL
    AND BCC.ISLATEST = '1'
UNION ALL

    SELECT
     BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS PeriodStartDate
    ,'99991231' AS PeriodEndDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PDT_NBR AS ProductId
    ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,FILE_NAME AS FileName
    ,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS FileDateKey
    ,'Daily' AS filetype
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	 WHERE  BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL
     AND BCC.ISLATEST = '1'
)A 
)
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'SRC' TABLES, 'CCD' SOURCE FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE RN = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'SRC' TABLES, 'DEP' SOURCE FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG WHERE BDG.ISLATEST = 1 
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'SRC' TABLES, 'LNS' SOURCE FROM BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG WHERE BLG.ISLATEST = '1' 
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'SRC' TABLES, 'SEC' SOURCE FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BST where BST.ISLATEST = '1'
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO) CNT, 'SRC' TABLES, 'TRU' SOURCE FROM BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO BTP
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION BTS ON BTP.Subscription_ID = BTS.Subscription_ID 
    WHERE BTP.isLatest = '1' AND BTS.isLatest = '1' 
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'TGT' TABLES, SOURCESYSTEMCODE FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
GROUP BY SOURCESYSTEMCODE
) A
ORDER BY SOURCE,TABLES


--------------------------DATA DUPLICATES
SELECT CustomerAccountId, SourceSystemCode, FinancialInstitutionId, COUNT(1) FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, SourceSystemCode, FinancialInstitutionId
HAVING COUNT(1)>1

--------------------------DATA validation

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
AS(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY FileDateKey DESC, FILETYPE DESC ) RN, * FROM 
    (
    SELECT
    BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS PeriodStartDate
    ,'99991231' AS PeriodEndDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PDT_NBR AS ProductId
    ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,FILE_NAME AS FileName
    ,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS FileDateKey
    ,'Monthly' AS filetype
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
    WHERE  BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL
    AND BCC.ISLATEST = '1'
UNION ALL

    SELECT
     BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS PeriodStartDate
    ,'99991231' AS PeriodEndDate
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PDT_NBR AS ProductId
    ,'PHP' AS IsoCurrencyCode
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,FILE_NAME AS FileName
    ,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS FileDateKey
    ,'Daily' AS filetype
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	 WHERE  BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL
     AND BCC.ISLATEST = '1'
)A 
), SRC AS(

    SELECT * FROM (
SELECT CustomerAccountId,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE RN = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT FORACID,BANK_ID,SOURCE_CODE FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG WHERE BDG.ISLATEST = 1 
UNION ALL
SELECT FORACID,BANK_ID,SOURCE_CODE FROM BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG WHERE BLG.ISLATEST = '1' 
UNION ALL
SELECT ACCTCODE,BNK_CODE,SOURCE_CODE FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BST where BST.ISLATEST = '1'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO,BTP.BNK_CODE,BTP.SOURCE_CODE FROM BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO BTP
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION BTS ON BTP.Subscription_ID = BTS.Subscription_ID 
    WHERE BTP.isLatest = '1' AND BTS.isLatest = '1' 
) A
)
, TGT AS (
    SELECT CustomerAccountId,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId  FROM  BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
)
, SRC_CNT AS (
---SRC
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM SRC WHERE NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT * FROM TGT)
)
, TGT_CNT AS (
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM TGT WHERE NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT * FROM SRC)
)

SELECT CNT FROM SRC_CNT
UNION ALL
SELECT CNT FROM TGT_CNT
